name: Room Escape Timer
description: Pressure, and the option to have none. An escape room may be timed, and the timer is a separate component precisely so it can be absent: the same room content should be playable as a relaxed exploration and as a sixty-minute panic without being authored twice. Penalties and bonuses adjust the clock rather than ending the room outright, and expiry is an event the room decides how to answer — some designs end, some unlock a worse ending, some simply stop counting. Pausing is allowed by default, because a single-player puzzle game that punishes answering the door is punishing the wrong thing.

inputs.name: durationSeconds
inputs.description: Starting clock. 0 disables the timer entirely.

inputs.name: hintPenaltySeconds
inputs.description: Time deducted when a hint is taken.

inputs.name: puzzleBonusSeconds
inputs.description: Time granted per lock opened. 0 keeps the clock honest.

inputs.name: pausable
inputs.description: Whether the clock may be paused.

outputs.name: expired
outputs.description: Whether the clock has run out.

outputs.name: paused
outputs.description: Whether the clock is currently held.
